latest.title: Latest values

thresholds.title: Normal ranges
thresholds.description: Set the usual range of each vital. A measurement outside it notifies the caregivers.
thresholds.readOnly: Normal ranges are set by admins and family members.
thresholds.clearHint: Clear the fields to remove the range.

form.title: New measurement
form.description: The measurement is shared with the whole circle.

errors.threshold: Could not save the normal range.
errors.pulseInvalid: Please enter the pulse as a number or leave the field empty.

restricted.title: Restricted access
restricted.description: Health tracking is visible to the family and professionals of the circle.

reminders.title: Measurement reminder
reminders.description: The care recipient is reminded to measure every day at the chosen time. If no value has been recorded 2 hours later, the family gets one notice.
reminders.readOnly: Measurement reminders are set by administrators and family.
reminders.hint: The reminder is done as soon as a value is recorded today.
reminders.saveError: The reminder could not be saved. Please try again.
reminders.timeInvalid: Please enter a valid time, for example 07:30.
